authentic_rule_recovery.claim: This contract does not recover, reproduce, certify, or complete an authentic Feitian or DD-line rule.

purpose: Bound a deterministic, auditable bare-K decision hypothesis derived only from local research statements and explicit provisional assumptions.

permitted_inputs: local research statements read after this contract is committed
permitted_outputs: deterministic context, candidate, confirmation, invalidation, abstain, and direction decisions
decision traces and verifier results on synthetic fixtures

non_anticipation_rule: At decision index t, every rule input must be computed solely from the bar at t and bars with index less than t. A fixture verifier must reject any trace that cites a bar after t.

source_policy.read_order: Commit this contract before opening source research.
source_policy.allowed_sources: Read-only paired-trading and trade-philosopher research; source statements are recorded as paraphrased, public-safe claims rather than raw excerpts.
source_policy.assumption_policy: Any material behavior lacking exact support is recorded as a named provisional assumption with rationale, source gap, expected impact, and a testable alternative. Assumptions are never presented as authentic Feitian behavior.

public_safety_rule: Public artifacts must not contain absolute paths, local usernames, credentials, tokens, proprietary raw research excerpts, raw market or option rows, or outcome/performance data.
acceptance_requirements: A deterministic bare-K rule surface defines context inputs, setup/candidate conditions, confirmation, invalidation, abstain/missing states, direction semantics, bar-close timing, observation window, and conflict precedence.
A source ledger and an assumption ledger identify every material behavior and its status.
Synthetic fixtures cover normal, invalidated, abstaining, missing, and conflict-precedence behavior.
Tests and a standalone verifier validate schema, provenance labels, non-anticipation, public-safety checks, and expected fixture decisions.
completion_gate: The deliverable remains an operationalized hypothesis. Authentic-rule recovery remains unresolved until separately sourced and reviewed.
